nominal_baseline.description: Unmodified food catalog and standard baseline constraints.
nominal_baseline.rationale: Establishes reference unperturbed performance under 5.0s budget.

food_avail_10pct.description: Modest food availability restriction (~10% active food removal, nested subset of 20%).
food_avail_10pct.rationale: Simulates modest catalog supply disruption while preserving category feasibility.

food_avail_20pct.description: Stronger food availability restriction (~20% active food removal, strict superset of 10%).
food_avail_20pct.rationale: Simulates acute supply shortage; strictly nests 10% removal for dose-response comparison.

dietary_excl_dairy.description: Complete dairy exclusion (5 items, lactose intolerance / vegan preference).
dietary_excl_dairy.safety_note: Preference/intolerance exclusion only; absence of dairy annotation does not certify allergen-free.
dietary_excl_dairy.rationale: Stresses calcium, B12, riboflavin, and protein optimization from non-dairy sources.

dietary_excl_legume.rationale: Evaluates clean failure detection under hard category rules in PV/combo and substitution in NonVeg.

nutrient_sens_pm5pct.description: One fixed nested proportional composition perturbation per severity; arithmetic replay only.
nutrient_sens_pm5pct.rationale: Quantifies uncertainty propagation: distinguishes nominal validity from perturbed compliance.

nutrient_sens_pm10pct.description: One fixed nested proportional composition perturbation per severity; arithmetic replay only.
nutrient_sens_pm10pct.rationale: Stresses nutritional robustness under higher lab/sourcing variance.
